Game Overview

In Space Escape, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Space Escape's vibrant pixel-art cosmos as a nimble alien, dodging a relentless hail of satellites. This endless arcade challenge demands quick reflexes and anticipation to set high scores. Keep moving skillfully and enjoy the nostalgic thrill of this captivating space adventure.
